svg.title: One GCN message-passing step at node 1
svg.desc: Path graph 0-1-2 with features 1, 2, 3. Node 1 gathers 0.4082 x 1, 0.3333 x 2 from its self-loop and 0.4082 x 3, sums them to 2.2997, multiplies by the shared weight w = 2 to get 4.599, and ReLU leaves 4.599.
svg.text: The same w is used at every node:
In general each arrow carries a d-vector,
the sum stays d wide, and W is d × dout​,
so the new hv​ has dout​ numbers.
Mean readout over the three nodes:
